decision_boundary: Whether corresponding DataTree nodes are matched by relative path or only by breadth-first position; preserve positional semantics for intentionally differently named trees.
hidden_invariants: Node-path identity and existing isomorphism/error behavior must both remain valid.
setup_cost: Low: shallow Python checkout and focused pytest tests run locally.
why_luna_may_fail: Sibling-order bug is distributed across DataTree mapping, path/isomorphism helpers, and regression semantics; a shallow positional fix can preserve the wrong pairing.
why_sol_helps: Sol may more reliably preserve the existing differently-named-tree behavior while introducing path-aware alignment and a narrow regression.
evaluator: Focused FAIL_TO_PASS and related DataTree tests; full suite available in task metadata.
screening_note: Clean offline A-lite and B-lite both passed. This task currently has no observed Sol/Luna separation, so it is not approved as T4 yet.

decision_boundary: Whether empty/None payloads dispatch through the correct subclass conversion path without changing public de_json behavior.
hidden_invariants: Subclass dispatch and the existing broad PASS_TO_PASS conversion contract.
setup_cost: Medium: Python package with a large focused test surface.
why_luna_may_fail: The requested de_json simplification crosses conversion dispatch and subclass behavior; broad fixture coverage can hide a narrow compatibility invariant.
why_sol_helps: A stronger model may keep the public conversion contract and avoid over-broad edits across the large test surface.
evaluator: Focused FAIL_TO_PASS plus a large PASS_TO_PASS set.
screening_note: Keep as a second candidate; do not promote without a clean A-lite/B-lite run.

why_sol_helps: Sol may resolve the framework boundary quickly without broad dependency archaeology.
evaluator: Focused request test and broad pytest command in task metadata.
screening_note: Two Luna attempts spent the bounded window on dependency/cache inspection and made no patch; no A-lite result was run, so this is not a model-quality failure.
